name: eval() runs text as code
why: If user input reaches eval, an attacker can run any code on your server or in your user's browser.
fix: Remove eval. Use JSON.parse for data or a safe lookup table for logic.

name: new Function() runs text as code
why: Same risk as eval: input can become running code.
fix: Replace with normal functions and explicit logic.

name: dangerouslySetInnerHTML
why: Unsanitized HTML lets attackers inject scripts (XSS) and steal sessions.
fix: Render text normally, or sanitize with DOMPurify before using it.

name: innerHTML assignment
why: Writing user data into innerHTML allows script injection (XSS).
fix: Use textContent, or sanitize the HTML first.

name: CORS allows every website
why: Any website can call your API from a visitor's browser.
fix: Set CORS origin to your own domain list, not * .

name: SQL built from strings (SQL injection)
why: An attacker can change your database query and read or delete all data.
fix: Use parameterized queries (placeholders like ? or $1), never string concatenation.

name: SSL certificate checks turned off
why: Attackers on the network can read or change your secure traffic.
fix: Remove the override and fix the certificate instead.

name: Debug mode on
why: Debug mode shows internal errors and sometimes gives attackers a console.
fix: Turn debug off in production using an environment variable.

name: Shell command built from strings
why: An attacker can run any command on your server (command injection).
fix: Use execFile with an argument array and validate inputs.
